target: Predecessor uniqueness outside periods1/2 under an infinite spatial PAST only. This includes every finite white-root path, since the zero root has a loop.
method: Repeat q2/4/8 complete profile graph, prune indegree0 only, retain dead ends.
interpretation: Test correct quantifiers before spending on a proof; a positive finite result is not a theorem.
